t: Navigating AI & Client Work: The 4-Tiered SEO Growth Strategy
s: This article details a 4-tiered SEO growth strategy to restore declining client traffic, emphasizing practical execution over AI-induced abstraction. It covers specific tactics like mass self-canonicalization of product pages and creating virtual categories, while warning against the 'Stormbringer' trap of disconnected AI use.
sub: 4-Tiered SEO Growth Blueprint for Traffic Recovery
Virtual Category Page Generation via Site Search & Footer Links
Leveraging Domain Expertise as AI Competitive Advantage
